personality_one_liner: A stark, command-center utility app focused on operational clarity, high information density, and mechanical directness.

spacing.rule: Utility-first: strong hierarchy, structural alignment, dense but highly readable spacing with distinct 1pt borders to separate operational modules.

dont's: No blur, no glassmorphism. This is a brutalist utility app. Rely on stark contrast and solid borders.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry point restricted to regional preset accounts (Pusdal).

states.loading: Centered loading text with mono font.
states.error: Stark red error message above the input block.

screens.layout: Centered structural box containing a dropdown for the preset 'Pusdal' accounts and password field. Hard bottom CTA button. Mono fonts for labels, sharp 1pt borders on inputs.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center listing the 6 primary data categories.
screens.layout: Grid of 6 stark, squared cards (TSO Lokomotif, TSO Kereta, TSO Gerbong, TSGO Lokomotif, TSGO Kereta, TSGO Gerbong) wrapped in 1pt borders. Each block clearly isolated. A prominent 'Rekap Text' action pinned at the bottom.

screens.name: List/Form
screens.purpose: Add and view items (Nomor + Keterangan) for a specific category.

states.empty: Empty state text with 1pt bordered container indicating 'No Data'.
states.error: Error text in mono font with strong outline.

screens.layout: Single column. Top section has inputs for 'Nomor' and 'Keterangan'. Underneath, a strict list of entries displaying data in mono-type. Pinned 'Submit' button at bottom with safe-area clearance.

screens.name: Rekap (Report)
screens.purpose: Display final structured text summary of all data for easy copying.
screens.layout: Full-width text area displaying raw data in a tabular plain-text format using JetBrains Mono for exact alignment. A massive, edge-to-edge 'Copy to Clipboard' sticky button at the bottom.

hero_train.alt: red and white train on rail near body of water during daytime

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile personality (Personality 5). No rounded corners (radius 0 everywhere), no shadows, no glassmorphism.
Use strong 1pt borders (`borderStrong` #09090B) to organize layout blocks. The app must look like a mechanical dashboard.
The primary brand color is KAI Orange (#EA580C) representing the signal color. Keep the rest of the UI stark white/grey (monochrome).
For typography, headings use Space Grotesk, but all data, metadata, forms, and the recap text MUST use JetBrains Mono to emulate a high-density utility terminal.
Maintain the Indonesian language ('Pusdal', 'Nomor', 'Keterangan', 'Rekap') throughout the UI.
Ensure the final 'Rekap' output is structured in a literal plain text block so the user can easily copy and paste it as requested in the problem statement.
Place primary action buttons in the thumb zone (sticky at the bottom).
